note: Adapted from the original Latin description by Silvestri as quoted by Hill (1942); Hill states expressly "This species is unknown to me", and the original has only the soldier. The Latin measurements "Long. corp. 4,6; long. capitis 1,56; lat. capitis 1,3; altitudo capitis 0,85; long. antennarum 1,43; mandibularum 0,76; tibiae III 0,91" are transcribed with comma decimals as 4.6/1.56/1.3/0.85/1.43/0.76/0.91 mm. The headline is OCR'd as "Hamitermes {Hamitermes)"; the checklist gives the type locality as "Daydown", whereas the original reads Day Dawn. Distribution and biology have not been translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Hill himself never saw specimens of this species; the original description, after Silvestri (1909), records only the soldier; its closest relative is A. hartmeyeri, with which it is compared under that species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Not recorded in the original (Not known).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: After Silvestri's original Latin description: head pale straw-coloured with a rusty ochre tint, with a long inverted-triangular milk-white patch from the vertex to the front of the frons; mandibles yellow rust-coloured; abdomen grey because of the contents. Head about one-sixth longer than wide, slightly narrowed both forwards and backwards, with fairly numerous setae. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 thinner and shorter than segment 4. Labrum short, nearly triangular, apex slightly rounded. Mandibles about half the head length, curved and pointed, with one large triangular tooth slightly inclined forwards. Anterior part of the pronotum distinctly upturned, margins broadly rounded, middle almost not concave, setae not numerous. Abdominal tergites and sternites with numerous short setae, the sternites also with long lateral setae; pleurites with very small tubercles each bearing one very short seta. Legs with rather numerous setae. Measurements: body length 4.6 mm, head length 1.56 mm, head width 1.3 mm, head height 0.85 mm, antennal length 1.43 mm, mandible length 0.76 mm, length of hind tibia 0.91 mm.
